claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_reroll
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Luck property grants a free reroll of one failed D20 Test per dawn. No reroll effect atom exists in types.ts. The v4 taxonomy names modify_roll_reroll but it is absent from the TS surface. The existing modify_roll_advantage and modify_roll_numeric atoms do not cover rerolling a die after it has already been rolled and failed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If the weapon is on your person, you can call on its luck (no action required) to reroll one failed D20 Test if you don't have the Incapacitated condition. You must use the second roll.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy — property_loss_on_empty variant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Wish charges being depleted causes only the Wish property to be lost, not the whole item. The current ItemDestructionPolicy discriminated union has none / last_charge_roll / permanent_on_empty, all of which apply to the entire item. A partial-property-loss variant is needed for items that shed individual charge-based abilities while retaining other mechanics.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The weapon loses this property if it has no charges.
